§6Purpose and mechanism§r
Keep a Large Geothermal Steam Boiler controller in your inventory to complete this item check; the items are not consumed. When building the boiler, match the tiered materials, then supply lava and water. The steel tier can use a Geothermal Overheat Chip for superheated output.

§3Preparation and operation§r
Plan boiler materials, lava delivery, and water supply together when choosing a tier. This controller check does not require connected fluids or an installed superheat chip; those belong to later construction and operation. For a steel-tier superheated route, verify downstream compatibility and plan either descaling or distilled-water supply so maintenance does not interrupt the whole network.
